name: Tiroler Genussabend
beschreibung: The Tiroler Genussabend in Innsbruck is a culinary experience of the refined kind: a top chef creates a multi-course menu from the finest ingredients Tyrol has to offer – from Alpine cheese and Tiroler Grauvieh cattle to wild berries. Each course is accompanied by a matching wine, for example from South Tyrol or Burgenland. For 149 euros, guests enjoy regional specialities for around three to four hours in a festive atmosphere. Innsbruck, the capital of Tyrol, lies amid the Alps and is known for combining urban flair with mountain scenery. The region stands for down-to-earth products such as mountain cheese, Speck and game. An evening of this kind fits into Tyrolean food culture, which emphasises tradition and high-quality ingredients from the surrounding area.
